content.text: {"abstained":false,"abstention_reason":"","answer":"The sources provide several details about welfare measures for transgender persons. An Umbrella Scheme is proposed with components including [E01][E03]: (i) Scholarship for transgender persons on the lines of similar scholarship schemes for SC students; (ii) Loan with 25% subsidy for transgender persons to enable them to take up self-employment ventures; (iii) A pension scheme for transgender persons above 40 years up to 60 years for ensuring financial security; and (iv) Grant-in-aid to Voluntary and other Organizations working for Empowerment of Transgender People, particularly for providing them vocational training [E01][E03]. Additionally, skill development training is provided through PM-DAKSH to improve educational and socio-economic conditions, with support for small business and self-employment [E02].
